description: THE LANE LEDGER - the single next task and the decisions it waits on, declared once so the board's Next section and the brief's section 1 are generated from it (src/analyse/build_status_board.py, block `lane`) and /onboard can put an open decision to the user as clickable choices instead of prose. A task is `open`, `done` (with the record section that closed it) or `dropped` (with why). A decision is unanswered until `answer` is set; /handoff records the answer here, in DECISIONS.md 14 and on the issue's AWAITING-DECISION line, and an answered decision is never asked again. Costs are quoted from src/analyse/arm_cost.py, never typed from memory. Edit with src/analyse/lane.py.

decisions.question: The routers pair ran all 250 iterations and shut down cleanly, but its harness died at iteration 34, so no `_run.json` exists and the gate is red. How is it closed out?

options.label: Add run.py --close-out; it is a RESULT (recommended)
options.detail: a launcher path for an orphaned run whose own log records a clean shutdown at its declared last iteration: `ran_to_last_iteration` at 250 through the framework's close_out(); refuses a live, short or unclean run

options.label: Let reconcile mark it aborted; cite at it.250
options.detail: the existing path: status aborted (or failed, on the survivable Guice throwable); a reading at reached_iteration 250, never a result

options.label: Leave it; the gate stays red

decisions.answer: Add run.py --close-out; it is a RESULT (recommended)

decisions.question: The harness is a child of the shell that launches it, and the fifty-second session's end killed the routers pair's harness at iteration 34 while its JVM ran on. What should the launch default be?

options.label: Detach by default (recommended)
options.detail: `run.py` registers the scheduled task unless `--foreground` is passed; the harness, its watchers and the record outlive any shell; `--detach` already runs every refusal first (§9.167)

options.label: Refuse a foreground launch under a Claude session
options.detail: `run.py` refuses when `CLAUDECODE` is in the environment and `--detach` is absent; a foreground launch from a terminal stays allowed

options.label: Leave the default; the operator remembers --detach
options.detail: the trap goes in the brief; a harness death recurs the next time it is forgotten

decisions.evidence: §9.176: the one launch since §9.72 not made `--detach` is the one whose harness died with the shell; no ceiling, stall or gate watcher ran from iteration ~35 to 250
decisions.note: Taken 16 Sep 2026: run.py registers the scheduled task unless --foreground is passed.
